security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: if any annual contract employee who meets the eligibility requirements to be issued another annual contract whose Principal or Director intends to recommend non-reappointment, both the Area Superintendent and the Chief Academic Officer shall be notified and shall confer with the Principal. Such recommendation of non-reappointment may not be forwarded to the Superintendent unless the Principal has conferred in advance with both the Area Superintendent and the Chief Academic Officer.
